source_refs.note: Exercise 10.4, Question 5 (3 parts): book page 199 (PDF 204). No answer key (proofs). Verified with sympy and the solution book.

blocks.explanation:
Chaar cosines ka product ek number ke barabar dikhana hai, wo bhi table ya calculator ke baghair. Aise sawalon mein hum product formula baar baar laga kar angles ko aisa banate hain ke aakhir mein terms cancel ho jayen.
Ek factor \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) hum pehle se jaante hain; baqi teen ko qadam ba qadam chhota karenge.
Plan: \(\cos 60^{\circ}\) bahar nikalein; \(\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}\) ko sum banayein; phir \(\cos 80^{\circ}\) se multiply kar ke dobara product formula; aakhir mein \(\cos 100^{\circ} = -\cos 80^{\circ}\) se cancel.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos 20^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 60^{\circ}\cos 80^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{16}\).
Tareeqa: \(2\cos\alpha\cos\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\) do dafa, aur \(\cos(180^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\). Kitab ne exercise se bilkul pehle \(\cos 20^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 80^{\circ} = \frac{1}{8}\) saabit kiya hai; yahan hum woh kaam dobara kar ke dikhate hain.

Maloom factor bahar nikalein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{2}\cos 20^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 80^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Ab sirf teen factors bache.

Pehle do factors se "2 cos cos" banayein
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(2\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ})\cos 80^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(\cos 60^{\circ} + \cos 20^{\circ})\cos 80^{\circ}\]
Kyun: 2 se multiply aur divide kiya, is liye \(\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{4}\) bahar aaya. Phir \(40^{\circ} + 20^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\) aur \(40^{\circ} - 20^{\circ} = 20^{\circ}\). Achhi baat: \(\cos 60^{\circ}\) phir se ek maloom value hai.

Bracket kholein
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\cos 80^{\circ} + \cos 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{8}\cos 80^{\circ} + \dfrac{1}{8}(2\cos 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ})\]
Kyun: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) rakha. Doosre term mein phir 2 ka factor banaya: \(\frac{1}{4} = \frac{1}{8}\times 2\), taa ke product formula lag sake.

Dobara product formula
\[2\cos 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ} = \cos 100^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{8}\left(\cos 80^{\circ} + \cos 100^{\circ} + \dfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
Kyun: \(80^{\circ} + 20^{\circ} = 100^{\circ}\), \(80^{\circ} - 20^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\). Ab \(\frac{1}{8}\) common le kar sab ek bracket mein rakh diya.

Allied angle se cancel karein
\[\cos 100^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} - 80^{\circ}) = -\cos 80^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{8}\cdot\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{16} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Second quadrant mein cosine negative hota hai, is liye \(\cos 100^{\circ} = -\cos 80^{\circ}\). \(\cos 80^{\circ}\) aur \(-\cos 80^{\circ}\) cancel ho gaye aur sirf \(\frac{1}{2}\) bacha. Yahi is sawal ka "jadoo" hai.

Tasdeeq calculator se
\[0.9397 \times 0.7660 \times 0.5 \times 0.1736\]
\[\approx 0.0625 = \dfrac{1}{16} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{16} = 0.0625\); dono barabar.

blocks.explanation:
Angles radians mein hain. Pehle inhein degrees mein badal lein: \(\frac{\pi}{9} = 20^{\circ}\), \(\frac{2\pi}{9} = 40^{\circ}\), \(\frac{\pi}{3} = 60^{\circ}\), \(\frac{4\pi}{9} = 80^{\circ}\). Ab pata chalta hai ke yeh part (i) ka sine wala roop hai.
Saabit kya karna hai? Product \(= \frac{3}{16}\).
Plan: \(\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) bahar nikalein, aur \(\sin 20^{\circ}\sin 40^{\circ}\sin 80^{\circ}\) ko product formulas se chhota karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \sin\frac{\pi}{9}\sin\frac{2\pi}{9}\sin\frac{\pi}{3}\sin\frac{4\pi}{9}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{3}{16}\).
Tareeqa: \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\) aur \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\).

Degrees mein badlein aur \(\sin 60^{\circ}\) bahar nikalein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \sin 20^{\circ}\sin 40^{\circ}\sin 60^{\circ}\sin 80^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin 20^{\circ}\sin 40^{\circ}\sin 80^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\pi\) radian \(= 180^{\circ}\), is liye \(\frac{\pi}{9} = \frac{180^{\circ}}{9} = 20^{\circ}\), isi tarah baqi. Degrees mein angles pehchanna aasaan hai.

\(\sin 40^{\circ}\sin 20^{\circ}\) se "2 sin sin" banayein
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(2\sin 40^{\circ}\sin 20^{\circ})\sin 80^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}(\cos 20^{\circ} - \cos 60^{\circ})\sin 80^{\circ}\]
Kyun: 2 se multiply aur divide; phir "sin sin" formula mein pehle farq \(20^{\circ}\), phir jama \(60^{\circ}\).

Bracket kholein
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\left(\sin 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ} - \dfrac{1}{2}\sin 80^{\circ}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{8}\left(2\sin 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ} - \sin 80^{\circ}\right)\]
Kyun: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). \(\frac{1}{2}\) bahar nikalne se pehle term mein "2 sin cos" ban gaya, jis par agla formula lagega.

Dobara product formula
\[2\sin 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ} = \sin 100^{\circ} + \sin 60^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{8}\;\times\]
\[\left(\sin 100^{\circ} + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \sin 80^{\circ}\right)\]
Kyun: \(80^{\circ} + 20^{\circ} = 100^{\circ}\), \(80^{\circ} - 20^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\), aur \(\sin 60^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\).

Allied angle se cancel karein
\[\sin 100^{\circ} = \sin(180^{\circ} - 80^{\circ}) = \sin 80^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{8}\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{3}{16} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Second quadrant mein sine positive hai, is liye \(\sin 100^{\circ} = \sin 80^{\circ}\), aur yeh \(-\sin 80^{\circ}\) se cancel ho gaya. \(\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3} = 3\).
Dhyan dein: Part (i) mein cosine ka sign badla tha, yahan sine ka nahi badla; quadrant ka asool yaad rakhein.

Tasdeeq calculator se
\[0.3420 \times 0.6428 \times 0.8660 \times 0.9848\]
\[\approx 0.1875 = \dfrac{3}{16} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{3}{16} = 0.1875\); dono barabar.

blocks.explanation:
Phir chaar sines ka product, aur ek maloom value \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) hai. Tareeqa part (ii) jaisa hi hai.
Saabit kya karna hai? Product \(= \frac{1}{16}\).
Plan: \(\sin 30^{\circ}\) bahar; \(\sin 50^{\circ}\sin 10^{\circ}\) ko cosines ka farq banayein; \(\sin 70^{\circ}\) se multiply; aakhir mein \(\sin 110^{\circ} = \sin 70^{\circ}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \sin 10^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ}\sin 50^{\circ}\sin 70^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{16}\).
Tareeqa: \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\) aur \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\). (Kitab ne degree ke nishan chhote primes ki tarah chhape hain; matlab degrees hi hai.)

Maloom factor bahar nikalein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{2}\sin 10^{\circ}\sin 50^{\circ}\sin 70^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\).

\(\sin 50^{\circ}\sin 10^{\circ}\) se "2 sin sin" banayein
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(2\sin 50^{\circ}\sin 10^{\circ})\sin 70^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(\cos 40^{\circ} - \cos 60^{\circ})\sin 70^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Farq \(50^{\circ} - 10^{\circ} = 40^{\circ}\) pehle, jama \(60^{\circ}\) baad mein. In do factors ko is liye chuna ke jama \(60^{\circ}\) banta hai jis ki value maloom hai.

Bracket kholein
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left(\sin 70^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ} - \dfrac{1}{2}\sin 70^{\circ}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{8}\left(2\sin 70^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ} - \sin 70^{\circ}\right)\]
Kyun: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\); \(\frac{1}{2}\) bahar nikalne se "2 sin cos" ban gaya.

Dobara product formula
\[2\sin 70^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ} = \sin 110^{\circ} + \sin 30^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{8}\left(\sin 110^{\circ} + \dfrac{1}{2} - \sin 70^{\circ}\right)\]
Kyun: \(70^{\circ} + 40^{\circ} = 110^{\circ}\), \(70^{\circ} - 40^{\circ} = 30^{\circ}\), aur \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\).

Allied angle se cancel karein
\[\sin 110^{\circ} = \sin(180^{\circ} - 70^{\circ}) = \sin 70^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{8}\cdot\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{16} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 110^{\circ}\) aur \(-\sin 70^{\circ}\) cancel ho gaye, sirf \(\frac{1}{2}\) bacha. Teeno parts mein yahi pattern hai: do product formulas aur ek allied angle.

Tasdeeq calculator se
\[0.1736 \times 0.5 \times 0.7660 \times 0.9397\]
\[\approx 0.0625 = \dfrac{1}{16} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{16} = 0.0625\); dono barabar.
